name: io.form/formio-uag
description: The Universal Agent Gateway (UAG) enables in-process agentic automation using Form.io.

environmentVariables.name: PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: API endpoint to Enterprise project or OSS server

environmentVariables.name: PROJECT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Project API Key (Enterprise) or ADMIN_KEY (OSS)

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Server admin key for Community Edition. Not required for Enterprise deployment.

environmentVariables.name: LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Form.io license for a self-hosted Enterprise deployment; when it includes the UAG it also enables the Agent API. Not required for Community Edition, or for a project on Form.io's hosted service (https://*.form.io).

environmentVariables.name: UAG_LICENSE
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated: use LICENSE_KEY. Still read until UAG 3.0.

environmentVariables.name: JWT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret used to generate and validate JWT tokens

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Server port (default: 3200)

environmentVariables.name: PROJECT_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Project cache refresh interval in seconds (default: 900)

environmentVariables.name: TEMPLATE_SYNC
environmentVariables.description: When a module's template is installed into the project: boot, refresh or off (default: boot)

environmentVariables.name: JWT_EXPIRE_TIME
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of the tokens the UAG issues, in minutes (default: 3600)

environmentVariables.name: PORTAL_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Enterprise Portal connection secret

environmentVariables.name: MONGO
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The UAG's own database (only uag-* collections, never submissions): run records, runs that survive a restart, remote MCP sign-in. Needs a license that includes the UAG.

environmentVariables.name: MONGO_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB driver configuration (JSON)

environmentVariables.name: UAG_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: The database to use on the MONGO connection. Default uag.

environmentVariables.name: TASK_RUN_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days run records are kept. Default 90; 0 keeps them forever.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The URL clients reach the UAG at, for the OAuth discovery documents remote MCP clients read. Derived from each request when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH
environmentVariables.description: true turns on OAuth sign-in for remote MCP clients. Needs MONGO.

environmentVariables.name: TRUST_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Express's trust proxy (true, a number of hops, or addresses). Set it behind a reverse proxy, so the UAG reads its public URL from the forwarded headers.

environmentVariables.name: LOGIN_FORM
environmentVariables.description: Public URL to login form JSON endpoint

environmentVariables.name: CORS
environmentVariables.description: true (the default) allows every origin, false turns CORS off, any other value is the one allowed origin

environmentVariables.name: DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Debug logging filter (e.g. formio.*)
